SVREAX

The National Weather Service in Pleasant Hill has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southern Adair County in northeastern Missouri...
Northeastern Linn County in north central Missouri...
Southeastern Sullivan County in north central Missouri...
Northern Macon County in north central Missouri...

* Until 930 AM CDT.

* At 842 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Milan, moving
east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Milan, La Plata, Green City, Greencastle, Elmer, South Gifford,
Reger, Green Castle, and Winigan.

At 940 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Fort Shawnee,
moving east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Nickel size hail, frequent cloud-to-ground lightning, and
very heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

cause serious injury or death. Visibility will be poor and
hydroplaning is possible.

Locations impacted include...
Kenton, Fort Shawnee, Cridersville, Alger, Waynesfield, Belle Center,
Chippewa Park, Northwood, Roundhead, Rushsylvania, Mcguffey,
Uniopolis, Silver Creek, Jumbo, Huntersville, Walton, New Hampshire,
Big Springs, and State Route 195 at State Route 235.

This includes I-75 in Ohio between mile markers 115 and 118.

events.summary:
TORLOT

The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
Northern La Salle County in north central Illinois...

* Until 915 AM CDT.

* At 836 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing both
tornadoes and extensive straight line wind damage were located near
Mendota, moving east at 50 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* These dangerous storms will be near...
Serena around 900 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include
Prairie Center, Norway, Triumph, Millington, Harding, Troy Grove,
Dayton, and Wedron.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Anderson County in central Kentucky...
West Central Jessamine County in central Kentucky...
Mercer County in central Kentucky...
Northeastern Nelson County in central Kentucky...
Washington County in central Kentucky...

* WHEN...Until 1230 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or is
imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 933 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.2 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bardstown, Lawrenceburg, Harrodsburg, Springfield, Ballard,
Burgin, Bloomfield, Willisburg, Mackville and Fairfield.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
